_comment: Allow rules live in settings.local.json: a project settings.json's allow rules are ignored until the workspace is trusted, which breaks unattended `claude -p --permission-mode dontAsk` runs. Deny rules and hooks below apply regardless of trust, and deny always beats allow. Note file rules use Edit(...) not Write(...) — Write rules are not evaluated by file permission checks, while Edit rules cover every file-editing tool.
